purpose: Ground-truth discovery prompt fixtures for adapter A/B comparison (hermes_local vs codex_local)

source_reference.template_basis: SOP v2 §3.1 Discovery Prompt template (model-agnostic adaptation)

notes: Use prompt text exactly as written.
Run each fixture across both adapters with identical runtime settings.
Evaluate structural conformance first, then content quality deltas.

executive_summary.description: 2-4 sentence summary of key findings and risk posture.

fixtures.title: Business Central E-Invoicing Readiness Risk Scan
fixtures.prompt: You are a D365 Business Central discovery analyst. Produce a decision-grade briefing on e-invoicing readiness risks for a US-based mid-market distributor running Business Central Online. Scope your analysis to capabilities, compliance, integration touchpoints, and rollout risks for multi-jurisdiction invoicing expansion (US + one EU country). Return structured findings with severity levels, confidence, and source-backed evidence. Include assumptions explicitly and identify the top evidence gaps requiring customer validation.
expected_focus: Operational rollout risk and remediation sequencing

fixtures.title: Dataverse Lead-to-Opportunity Data Quality Failure Modes
fixtures.prompt: You are a Dynamics 365 Sales and Dataverse discovery analyst. Evaluate likely high-impact data quality failure modes in a lead-to-opportunity process for a B2B services company using Dynamics 365 Sales Enterprise with custom Dataverse tables. Identify failure patterns, business impact, monitoring signals, and mitigation actions. Use model-agnostic severity and claim typing, provide confidence per claim, and attach evidence snippets with links.
expected_focus: Duplicate, stale, or incomplete lead/account data

fixtures.title: Cross-App Quote-to-Cash Automation Risk Assessment
fixtures.prompt: You are a cross-app D365 and Power Platform discovery analyst. Build a structured risk assessment for quote-to-cash automation spanning Dynamics 365 Sales, Business Central, Dataverse, and Power Automate. Assume current-state integrations rely on a mix of standard connectors and custom APIs. Identify interoperability risks, governance controls, and failure containment strategies. Provide at least three source-backed claims, classify claim type and severity, and include concrete follow-up questions for architecture validation.
expected_focus: Boundary ownership between Sales, BC, and Dataverse
Power Automate flow reliability and observability
